title: Light the pilot lights
brief: Green is lit while Button 1 is pressed. Amber is lit only while Button 1 AND Button 2 are both pressed. Red is lit while the Mode switch is in Manual.
hints: Each light needs its own rung, with its coil at the right-hand end.
For AND, put two contacts one after the other (in series). Power must pass through both.
Mode is FALSE in Manual. Which kind of contact passes power when its tag is FALSE?

scenarios.name: Button 1 lights green

assertions.says: Green should be lit while Button 1 is pressed.
Amber should stay off with only one button pressed.
Green should go off when Button 1 is released.

scenarios.hint: One normally open contact of PB1, then the Green coil.

scenarios.name: Both buttons light amber

assertions.says: Amber should be lit while both buttons are pressed.
Amber should go off when Button 2 is released.

scenarios.hint: For AND, put two contacts one after the other (in series): PB1, then PB2, then the Amber coil.

scenarios.name: Red shows Manual

assertions.says: Red should be lit with the Mode switch in Manual.
Red should go off when the switch is turned to Auto.

scenarios.hint: Mode is FALSE in Manual. A normally closed contact passes power while its tag is FALSE.
